before: Maze Runner is a single-screen, time-limited spatial navigation game. The player moves through a fixed grid maze and must reach the exit before the 30-second countdown expires.
after: Maze Runner is a single-screen, time-limited spatial navigation game. The player moves through a fixed grid maze and must reach the exit before the 45-second countdown expires.

before: The exit is located at `(row=13, col=12)`, corresponding to cell center `(500, 640)`.
after: The exit is located at `(row=13, col=13)`, corresponding to cell center `(540, 640)`.

before: The exit is fixed at `(row=13, col=12)` and is an enterable cell.
after: The exit is fixed at `(row=13, col=13)` and is an enterable cell.

before: The game uses a 30-second countdown based on actual elapsed time.
after: The game uses a 45-second countdown based on actual elapsed time.

before: The maze layout, total duration of 30 seconds, movement-repeat interval of 0.15 seconds, player starting position, and exit position remain fixed for every run.
after: The maze layout, total duration of 45 seconds, movement-repeat interval of 0.15 seconds, player starting position `(row=1, col=1)`, and exit position `(row=13, col=13)` remain fixed for every run.

before: The player's only objective is to move from the starting position to the exit before the 30-second countdown expires.
after: The player's only objective is to move from the starting position to the exit before the 45-second countdown expires.

before: Time starts at 30, decreases according to actual elapsed time, and never displays below 0. Steps starts at 0 and increases only after successful movement.
after: Time starts at 45, decreases according to actual elapsed time, and never displays below 0. Steps starts at 0 and increases only after successful movement.
